media.title: Es wird schon wieder besser (1932) — Der Kinematograph, no. 2 advertisement
media.description: Trade-press advertisement for Es wird schon wieder besser (1932), published in Der Kinematograph, no. 2.
media.altText: Film-trade press advertisement for Es wird schon wieder besser at the UFA Gloria-Palast, printed in Der Kinematograph, no. 2, 1932.
media.rightsNote: Reuse rights are not cleared. The advertisement was published in the German trade paper Der Kinematograph, no. 2 (1932), without a designer’s credit, so it is treated as an anonymous work whose German term of seventy years from publication ran out at the end of 2002. It was therefore still protected on 1 January 1996 and the URAA restored United States copyright for ninety-five years from publication, to the end of 2027. The Media History Digital Library permits use of material in its collection in teaching, research and publications, but that permission covers the digitised volume it supplies and not the copyright in the advertisement. An attributed excerpt is used here for scholarly documentation. The local copy is reduced to 606 × 800 px.

timelineEvents.title: Flourishing Berlin collaboration
timelineEvents.label: 1932 · Berlin collaboration flourishes
timelineEvents.shortDescription: The Jurmann–Kaper partnership flourished across German films and popular songs.
timelineEvents.longDescription: Jurmann and Kaper wrote music for numerous German films, including Hochzeitsreise zu Dritt, Skandal in der Parkstraße and Es wird schon wieder besser. Der glückliche Herr Fünf was announced in 1932 and released in 1933 as Ich will Dich Liebe lehren.
